policy: Companion to holds.json. holds.json says which printed pages are withheld; this file says what in the derived layer — the Series Index, the gazetteer, the timeline, the people index, the printed contents — would otherwise lead a reader to them. Nothing listed here is rendered.
render_rule: Every list here is a deny-list applied in src/components/zybach/soapcreek/data.ts before any page sees the data. Fields beginning `_internal` are the Library's working record and must never reach a page.
reason_classes: site-location — names or fixes the position of an American Indian burial, grave, artifact scatter or archaeological site
leads-to-held — the reference itself is harmless but its target is a held page

chapters._internal_reason: site-location — the printed chapter title names the subject of the pages it heads; all of its pages are held.
site-location — the printed chapter title pairs a named property with an excavation; all of its pages are held.

entries._internal_reason: leads-to-held — the printed table-of-contents line reproduces a suppressed chapter title and its page number.
site-location — the heading itself is a finding aid to sites.

subentries._internal_reason: site-location — each of these subheadings gathers, under one label, the page references that together locate sites across the series. The parent heading and its other subheadings stay: Native history is not withheld.

chronology._internal_reason: site-location — dates a named artifact find to a named peak.
site-location — the same find, restated from the thesis.
leads-to-held — describes the contents of a withheld table.
leads-to-held — points the reader to a withheld table.

thesis._internal_figures_reason: site-location — Figure 12's printed title names a find and the peak it came from.

dated_statements._internal_reason: leads-to-held — describes the contents of a withheld table.
leads-to-held — points the reader to a withheld table.

thesis._internal_tables_reason: Table D.1's rows are held with printed pp.250-251; the row data must not be rendered from thesis.json either.

statement_rewrites.was: and describe the locations of American Indian burial and artifact sites.
statement_rewrites.now: and some describe the locations of American Indian burial and artifact sites; those pages are held while the Library consults the Confederated Tribes of Grand Ronde and the Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians.
statement_rewrites._internal_reason: The collection statement described the material in the present tense after it was withheld. Same substitution the content-note page makes, applied once at the data layer so every surface reads the same.

_internal_statement_patterns_note: A last-resort filter applied only to short derived-layer strings — chronology statements, thesis dated statements, gazetteer evidence quotes, place notes and index headings. It is never applied to transcript body text, which is withheld page by page instead.
